mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, leading to wage inflation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three months signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) above 2% month-over-month signals increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4%, it signals a potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) below 1 million units signals weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases, it signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal.
